INFO 2000.finalExam: All exams, the final included, are cumulative but focus on topics near the exam date.

materials.item: Laptop to bring to class for programming exercises (no textbook; free tools only)

INFO 2000.attendance: Students are expected to attend and take part in class activities; each class is half lecture, half exercises.
INFO 2000.lateWork: Without an approved extension, the maximum possible grade drops by 10% of the remaining credit per day (multiplicative, not flat); extensions must be requested before the deadline.
INFO 2000.makeups: For an approved reason, contact the instructor before exam day to arrange a make-up; missing an exam without prior written permission scores 0.
other: Communication quality counts for 30% of the grade on all written assignments and oral presentations (department policy).
Suspected grading errors must go to the section instructor within one week; the whole assignment may be regraded.
Academic misconduct brings a zero on the assignment and may lead to a course F, transcript notation, suspension, dismissal or expulsion.
